methods.name: Standard Array
methods.text: Use the following six scores for your abilities: 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8.

methods.name: Point Buy
methods.text: You have 27 points to spend on your ability scores. The cost of each score is shown in the table. For example, a score of 14 costs 7 of your 27 points.
